# SCI-POINT v0.1 Author Supersession And Firewall Cover

Identity: `SCI-POINT_AUTHOR_SUPERSESSION_COVER v0.1/r0.3`

Status: candidate binding cover; exact packet approval pending

## Governing Rule

The packet formalizes a mature bright-source Pointing fitter without deriving
a replacement. Owner decisions in
`SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISIONS_FOR_AUTHORSHIP.md` control every conflicting or
less-specific statement in the packet.

The author shall preserve the approved estimand and boundaries while supplying
clear mathematics, terminology, stable identities, edge cases, requirements,
predictions, and traceability. Clean exposition is authorized; scientific
redesign is not.

## Information Firewall

The author may inspect only `AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md` and the exact objects
listed there. The author must not inspect or use:

- Stage A recovery records, internal dossiers, implementation inventories,
  raw owner discussion, raw approval records, decision/change logs, or package
  status material;
- source code, headers, configuration, defaults, schemas, product registries,
  tests, audits, repair notes, validation, reductions, generated products,
  logs, baselines, accepted runs, performance evidence, or Unity material;
- the full MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, FLT-MATCHED, FRUIT, AST, CAL, BEAM, NOI, VAL,
  OOF, SRC, or other package;
- external papers, web sources, unlisted repository files, or model memory as
  substitute authority; or
- filenames such as `raw` or `filtered` as scientific route identities.

Paths and authority names inside admitted objects are provenance and ownership
statements, not permission to open another source.

## Working-Wheel Constraint

The adopted compatibility-method target/family is the established
zero-background six-parameter elliptical-Gaussian Pointing fit with its
configurable search, initialization, bounded domain, and constraints. The
author shall not add a background parameter, another source model, blind
detection, automatic route choice, coadd fitting, or an aggregate/correction
operator.

The complete numerical compatibility method and the distinct formal-error
method are currently unavailable pending separate content-bound recovery and
owner approval. The author may specify their required records and conditional
dependencies, but may not infer or invent the published width convention,
objective/weights, search/fallback procedure, solution rule, or formal-error
calculation. The distinct full-map-RMS method is also unavailable; its absence
blocks only the descriptive amplitude/full-map-RMS diagnostic.

Where an exact numerical value is intentionally configurable, the author shall
specify its requested/effective/realized identity and scientific domain rather
than inventing a default. Where the packet leaves a representation or policy
mechanic to the author, the author may propose a collision-free exact form for
owner review but may not claim it is already approved.

## Stop Rule

If the packet cannot support a complete scientific statement, return one
precise question. Do not inspect a forbidden source or fill the gap from
implementation behavior.
